U2-Netp salient-object model (u2netp.onnx, about 4.4 MB)
https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net
Weights file used here:
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/u2netp.onnx

What this is
A small salient-object network. Find subject runs it in the browser through
ONNX Runtime (vendor/onnx) and keeps the result on the device. It is not
precached, and it is not loaded on a phone in the light memory tier.
